dedupe_keys.name: building energy estimation using machine learning rennes use case

description: Mohamed-Bachir Belaid and Babak Ebrahimi publish XGBoost estimates of building energy demand in Rennes through FAIRiCUBE. The July 2025 CSV deposit is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. Its predictors include number of levels, construction year and the area of opaque vertical walls through which heat is lost. The resulting building-level estimates support neighbourhood-stock assessment and can provide demand assumptions for urban energy simulations. This Rennes method uses different input attributes from the companion Oslo and Barcelona records. Output units, building coverage, weather assumptions and prediction error remain unknown from the short public description. The results should therefore be treated as estimated demand, not observed consumption. No related catalogue or first-review record explicitly includes this table. The CSV and underlying training observations were not downloaded.
